requirements.title: A CONTAINS statement is the keyword CONTAINS
requirements.definition: The CONTAINS statement syntax is the single keyword CONTAINS.

requirements.title: CONTAINS separates a program-unit body from contained subprograms
requirements.definition: The CONTAINS statement separates the body of a main program, module, submodule, or subprogram from internal or module subprograms it contains.

pending.main-program-internal-subprogram-after-c: Main program initializes x=-8, CALL touch(x), and internal subroutine touch after CONTAINS sets x=8.
pending.module-subprogram-after-contains: Module has CONTAINS followed by subroutine touch(x); a USEing program observes x changes from -9 to 9.
pending.host-subprogram-internal-subprogram-afte: External subroutine host contains internal subroutine inner after CONTAINS; CALL host changes caller sentinel -10 to 10 via inner.

review_rationale: Source registration for 15.6.2.6 (ENTRY), 15.6.2.7 (RETURN), 15.6.2.8 (CONTAINS), 15.6.3 (procedures defined by means other than Fortran) and 15.6.4 (statement functions) (batch236). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; R1544-R1547 and C1579-C1591 had no existing tests and carry conforming one-feature controls, and non-Fortran procedures are observed through mixed Fortran/C builds. Source accounting only; completes Clause 15.
